title: What If You Traveled at 99 Percent the Speed of Light?

scenes.text: What if you flew at 99 percent of light speed? Your clock would run seven times slower.
That's time dilation. The faster you move, the slower time passes for you, compared with everyone you left behind.
The nearest star system, Alpha Centauri, is about four point four light years away. You'd arrive in about seven and a half months, by your own clock.
But on Earth, more than four years would pass.
Stay out for ten years by your own clock, and about 71 years pass back home.
Every kilogram of ship would need roughly 130 megatons of TNT in energy just to get there.
